critique.evidence: The headline and supporting sentence state the thesis clearly, and “Compare configurations” provides a next action. However, the primary precision–recall chart is not self-explanatory: its x-axis repeats “100%” across nearly every tick before ending at “65%,” undermining trust and interpretability. Dense, very small labels and explanatory copy are difficult to read on mobile, while the mobile/tablet header hides the current Metrics location inside a horizontal rail. The ablation section also mixes PR-AUC degradation with unchanged 100% fresh-row recall without a concise explanation of why that supports the main claim.
critique.fix: Correct and clearly scale the precision–recall axes, add a one-sentence takeaway beside each chart, enlarge mobile labels/body copy, visibly preserve the active “Metrics” location in the header, and connect the ablation evidence directly to the decision users should make before the comparison CTA.
